topic: Buying an Intercity Bus Ticket at the Terminal

script.title: AT THE BUS TERMINAL
script.scene_zh: 城際巴士站 · 櫃台購票
script.story_hook: One big bag, one sleepy seat, one bus.
script.intro_zh: 一個大行李、一個好睡的座位、一班長途巴士。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the busy bus terminal. Listen for ticket buying phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到熱鬧的巴士總站。留意購票相關的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's a ticket, a seat, and a journey. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 一張票、一個座位、一趟旅程就這樣備齊。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to repeat every line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在輪到跟我一起逐句跟讀了。
script.title_quote: a map app in human form
script.char_a_description: a tired young man in his early twenties with long straight black hair tied in a small bun, round glasses, an olive green rain jacket, a rolling suitcase behind him, and a narrow build
script.char_b_description: a chipper older man in his fifties with slicked-back salt-and-pepper hair, a thinning moustache, a burgundy ticket-counter vest over a white shirt, a small bow tie, and a compact build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, one ticket to Columbus, today, if you have it.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ wʌn ˈtɪkɪt tə ˈkʌləməs təˈdeɪ ɪf ju hæv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，要一張今天到哥倫布市的車票，如果還有票的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do, the eleven fifteen or the two fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ði ɪˈlɛvən fɪfˈtin ɔɹ ðə tu fɪfˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 有票，十一點十五那班，還是下午兩點十五？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one gets there before dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn ɡɛts ðɛɹ bɪˈfɔɹ dɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 哪一班能在天黑前抵達？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both do, but the early one stops less.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ du bʌt ði ˈɝli wʌn stɑps lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 兩班都來得及，但早班停靠站較少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, um, the early one, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ʌm ði ˈɝli wʌn pliz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，嗯，就早班那趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're on it. Window or aisle seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɑn ɪt ˈwɪndoʊ ɔɹ ˈaɪəl sit/
dialogue.zh: 訂好了。要靠窗還是走道座位？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aisle, my legs are longer than my patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪəl maɪ lɛɡz ɑɹ ˈlɔŋɡɚ ðæn maɪ ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 走道吧，我的腿比我的耐心還要長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, seat fourteen, back left, quiet zone.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ sit fɔɹˈtin bæk lɛft ˈkwaɪət zoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，十四號座，左後方，安靜區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet zone? Um, what's that one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət zoʊn ʌm wʌts ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 安靜區？嗯，那是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No phone calls, no loud bags, sleepy people.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ foʊn kɔlz noʊ laʊd bæɡz ˈsliːpi ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 不講電話、不弄出大聲響，都是愛睡的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold, I'll be the sleepiest one there.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld aɪl bi ðə ˈsliːpiəst wʌn ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 成交，我會是那區睡得最沉的乘客。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Challenge accepted. Now, forty-two dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃælɪndʒ ɪkˈsɛptɪd naʊ ˈfɔɹɾi tu ˈdɑləz/
dialogue.zh: 挑戰我收下了。總共四十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, please, um, tap or insert?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd pliz ʌm tæp ɔɹ ɪnˈsɝt/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡，嗯，是輕碰還是插卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it, the machine beeps, you're golden.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ɪt ðə məˈʃin bipz jʊɹ ˈɡoʊldən/
dialogue.zh: 輕碰就好，機器一嗶，你就搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I like that phrase, you're golden.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ laɪk ðæt ˈfɹeɪz jʊɹ ˈɡoʊldən/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我喜歡這個說法，搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my favorite payment word, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt ˈpeɪmənt wɝd hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我最愛的收款台台詞，哈哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what's the bag rule? I have a big one.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌts ðə bæɡ ɹul aɪ hæv ə bɪɡ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那行李規則呢？我帶了一個很大箱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One under the bus, one tiny backpack inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈʌndɚ ðə bʌs wʌn ˈtaɪni ˈbækˌpɑk ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 一個放車底下的貨艙，一個小背包可帶進車廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine is the size of a small fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz ðə saɪz əv ə smɔl frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我那顆跟一台小冰箱一樣大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fridges ride under the bus, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfrɪdʒəz raɪd ˈʌndɚ ðə bʌs noʊ ˈpɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 冰箱尺寸的行李就走貨艙，完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh relief. Um, how long is the ride?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɹɪˈlif ʌm haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðə raɪd/
dialogue.zh: 呼，放心了。嗯，車程大約多長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four and a half hours, traffic permitting.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ ænd ə hæf ˈaʊɚz ˈtɹæfɪk pɚˈmɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 四個半小時，視路況而定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a stop for food on the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛɹ ə stɑp fɚ fud ɑn ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 途中有沒有吃東西的停靠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one rest stop, twenty minutes, midway.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ɹɛst stɑp ˈtwɛnɾi ˈmɪnɪts ˈmɪdˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有，中途一個休息站，二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty? Does the bus wait if I'm slow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnɾi dʌz ðə bʌs weɪt ɪf aɪm sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘？如果我慢吞吞，車會等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The doors close right on time, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔɹz kloʊz ɹaɪt ɑn taɪm ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，時間一到車門就關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, I'll sprint back from the bathroom then.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ aɪl sprint bæk fɹəm ðə ˈbæθˌrum ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那上完廁所我就一路小跑回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart plan. Seat fourteen, back left, remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt plæn sit fɔɹˈtin bæk lɛft ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。十四號座，左後方，記得喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one small problem, um... my ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌn smɔl ˈpɑbləm ʌm maɪ ˈtɪkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，有個小問題，嗯……我的車票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ticket? It's digital, sent to your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtɪkɪt ɪts ˈdɪdʒɪtəl sɛnt tə jɔɹ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 車票？它是電子票，已經傳進你手機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the problem, um, my phone is dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈpɑbləm ʌm maɪ foʊn ɪz dɛd/
dialogue.zh: 問題就在這裡，嗯，我的手機沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, drama. No worry, I'll print you paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ˈdɹɑmə noʊ ˈwɝi aɪl prɪnt ju ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 啊，一齣大戲。別擔心，我幫你印一張紙票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can? Oh, hero, thank you, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kən oʊ ˈhɪɹoʊ θæŋk ju ˈsɪɹəsli/
dialogue.zh: 可以嗎？噢，救星，真的謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There we go, one ticket, warm from the printer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ wi ɡoʊ wʌn ˈtɪkɪt wɔɹm fɹəm ðə ˈprɪnɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好了，車票一張，還帶著印表機的溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, it is warm, that's a first for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪt ɪz wɔɹm ðæts ə fɝst fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，真的是溫熱的，對我還是頭一遭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We also sell water and chips, three dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔlsoʊ sɛl ˈwɔɾɚ ænd tʃɪps θɹi ˈdɑləz/
dialogue.zh: 我們也賣礦泉水和薯片，三塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, grab me one water, um, sparkling?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡɹæb mi wʌn ˈwɔɾɚ ʌm ˈspɑɹklɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，給我一瓶水，嗯，有氣泡的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still only, sorry, sparkling is a train thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ˈoʊnli ˈsɑɹi ˈspɑɹklɪŋ ɪz ə tɹen θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 只有平的那種，抱歉，氣泡水是火車那邊的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fair, then still water is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ ðɛn stɪl ˈwɔɾɚ ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，合理，那無氣泡的也不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's forty-five, cheaper than an Uber ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈfɔɹɾi faɪv ˈtʃipɚ ðæn ən ˈuˌbɹaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 總計四十五塊，比叫一輛網約車便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True story, um, can I change my seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu ˈstɔɹi ʌm kən aɪ tʃeɪndʒ maɪ sit/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是。嗯，我還可以換座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only before boarding, and your ticket's printed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli bɪˈfɔɹ ˈbɔɹdɪŋ ænd jɔɹ ˈtɪkɪts ˈprɪnɾɪd/
dialogue.zh: 只在登車前可以換，你的票都印好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then fourteen is my home now, I accept.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn fɔɹˈtin ɪz maɪ hoʊm naʊ aɪ əkˈsɛpt/
dialogue.zh: 那十四號就是我現在的家，我認了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bus forty-one boards at gate letter B.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌs ˈfɔɹɾi wʌn bɔɹdz æt ɡeɪt ˈlɛɾɚ bi/
dialogue.zh: 四十一號巴士在 B 號閘口登車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gate B, and when do the doors open?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡeɪt bi ænd wɛn du ðə dɔɹz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: B 閘口，那幾點開放登車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven, so you've got fifteen calm minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən soʊ juz ɡɑt fɪfˈtin kɑm ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 十一點開門，所以你還有從容的十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just enough to find coffee and stretch legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌs ɪˈnʌf tə faɪnd ˈkɔfi ænd stɹɛtʃ lɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 剛好夠買杯咖啡，再伸展一下腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee cart is behind you, next to restrooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi kɑɹt ɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ju nɛkst tə ˈɹɛstˌɹumz/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡車就在你身後，洗手間隔壁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a map app in human form, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ə mæp æp ɪn ˈhjuːmən fɔɹm waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你根本是人類形態的地圖軟體，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Compliment received, ha. Safe travels, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəmˈplɪmənt ɹɪˈsivd hɑ seɪf ˈtɹævəlz fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 稱讚我收下了，哈哈。旅途平安，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Oh, last thing, can I bring snacks?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks oʊ læst θɪŋ kən aɪ brɪŋ snæks/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！噢，最後一件事，我可以帶零食嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, avoid smelly fish, that's the only law.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs əˈvɔɪd ˈsmɛli fɪʃ ðæts ðə ˈoʊnli lɔ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，避開味道重的魚類食物，那是唯一的規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, no fish, sleeping instead, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾɪd noʊ fɪʃ ˈslipɪŋ ɪnˈstɛd hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，不帶魚，改一路補覺，哈哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One warning, seat fourteen has a squeak.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈwɔɹnɪŋ sit fɔɹˈtin hæz ə swik/
dialogue.zh: 提醒一件事，十四號座位會吱吱響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A squeak? Does that mean something bad?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə swik dʌz ðæt min ˈsʌmθɪŋ bæd/
dialogue.zh: 吱吱響？那代表什麼壞事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When you sit down, it announces you, kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ju sit daʊn ɪt əˈnaʊns ju ˈkaɪndli/
dialogue.zh: 你一坐下，它就好心地向全車宣布你來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I'll be famous all the way to Columbus.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪl bi ˈfeɪməs ɔl ðə weɪ tə ˈkʌləməs/
dialogue.zh: 那我會一路出名到哥倫布市了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Local celebrity, ha, enjoy the ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊkəˌsɛlɪbəɹi hɑ ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə raɪd/
dialogue.zh: 當地名人囉，哈哈，好好享受車程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for saving my phone-free day.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɚ ˈseɪvɪŋ maɪ foʊn fri deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你拯救我沒有手機的這一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go get warm coffee, gate B, bye friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɡɛt wɔɹm ˈkɔfi ɡeɪt bi baɪ fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 去買杯溫熱咖啡吧，B 閘口見，再見朋友。

script.youtube_title: 【第一次搭長途巴士🚌】「你是人類形態的地圖軟體」車站買票全流程🎫🎧｜聽完就能自己上路｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Buying an Intercity Bus Ticket
script.youtube_title_en: "A Map App in Human Form" — Buying an Intercity Bus Ticket at the Terminal
script.youtube_description:
「你根本是人類形態的地圖軟體」——在巴士總站買一張長途車票，到底能聊多深？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就擠在購票櫃台前。

你會聽到：比較班次與抵達時間、挑選走道座位與安靜區；說清大行李怎麼放、車程多長、中途休息站停多久；手機沒電時請站務印紙票；再加上刷卡輕碰、水與零食規定、閘口與登車時間的完整問答。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人聊天時的真實語感：um、so、ha、wow。聽完你就會用：One ticket to...、Which one gets there...、Tap or insert、Print you paper、Safe travels。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜看完請訂閱，記得打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"You're a map app in human form" — how much can one ticket counter conversation teach? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice at a busy intercity bus terminal.

You will hear: comparing departure times, choosing an aisle seat in the quiet zone, explaining an oversized bag, asking about the rest stop and its twenty-minute rule, getting a paper ticket printed when your phone is dead, plus tap-to-pay, snacks, and gate boarding details.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the real spoken texture of Americans at a counter: um, so, ha, wow. By the end you'll own phrases like One ticket to..., Which one gets there...?, and Safe travels.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new practical scene.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次搭長途巴士，早班跟晚班差在哪？大行李上不上得了車？手機剛好沒電，電子票怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進巴士總站的購票櫃台，從比較班次、挑安靜區座位，到交代行李、刷卡、印紙票，最後問清閘口與登車時間，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🎫 開場買票：Hi, one ticket to Columbus, today, if you have it.
🧳 問行李：So, what's the bag rule? I have a big one.
🔋 沒電救援：That's the problem, um, my phone is dead.
😴 座位趣聞：When you sit down, it announces you, kindly.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、so、wow 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。跟著買完這張票，下次自己站到櫃台前，話自然從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你的每一段車程，都睡得安穩、到得準時。
